features.name: departure_time_norm
features.description: Scheduled departure minute scaled from observed training-fold bounds of 15 to 1439.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a monotone timing coordinate that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: scheduled_length_norm
features.description: Scheduled flight duration scaled from observed training-fold bounds of 25 to 560 minutes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures broad trip-duration effects with a stable unitless scale.

features.name: log_length_norm
features.description: Compressed duration score that reduces the influence of very long itineraries while preserving order.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a concave duration basis so a linear margin can model diminishing changes with trip length.

features.name: trip_end_day_fraction
features.description: Scheduled departure plus duration expressed as fractions of a day; values above 1 indicate carryover past midnight.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines timing and duration into an approximate linear projection of schedule position and end-of-day pressure.

features.name: late_day_pressure
features.description: Piecewise-linear score increasing after 15:00 and saturating by 21:00.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets the linear SVM assign a direct weight to later-day schedule accumulation.

features.name: commute_peak_score
features.description: Triangular score around morning 08:00 and evening 17:00 peak operating windows with a three-hour half-width.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth peak-window basis for non-monotone time-of-day effects.

features.name: airline_activity_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map Airline to log-scaled training-fold frequency divided by the largest airline frequency; unseen codes receive 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns carrier identity into a dense scalar reflecting network scale and operational footprint.

features.name: flight_number_recurrence_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map Flight to log-scaled frequency in the training fold divided by the largest flight-number frequency; unseen values receive 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates one-off flight numbers from recurring services without sparse one-hot dependence.

features.name: origin_airport_activity_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map AirportFrom to log-scaled departure count in the training fold divided by the largest origin-airport count; unseen airports receive 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents origin-side traffic density in a single smooth coordinate for linear weighting.

features.name: destination_airport_activity_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map AirportTo to log-scaled arrival count in the training fold divided by the largest destination-airport count; unseen airports receive 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents destination-side traffic density in a single smooth coordinate for linear weighting.

features.name: route_pair_activity_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map the AirportFrom-AirportTo pair to log-scaled pair frequency in the training fold divided by the most frequent pair count; unseen pairs receive 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures common-route structure and network familiarity as a dense scalar.

features.name: day_of_week_service_density_score
features.description: Semantic metadata lookup: map DayOfWeek to its training-fold frequency divided by the busiest observed weekday frequency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes service-density variation across the weekly cycle with one continuous value.
